mathematics.kind: primary independent mathematical derivation, not independent second review
mathematics.fold_assignment: The closed packet has layered open top/left edges; bottom/right are crease edges. Gray front versus banded reverse is material-side coding retained unchanged.
mathematics.normalized_setup: Take Q=[0,1]^2 in the coincident closed stack, creases x=1 and y=0. The given cut joins P=(1/2,0) to R=(1,1/2), cutting off triangle T with third vertex C=(1,0).
mathematics.constructive_result: The union of those four closed triangles has boundary vertices (1/2,0),(1,1/2),(3/2,0),(1,-1/2). Its interior is a single central diamond in the full square [0,2] x [-1,1], with area 1/2, i.e. 1/8 of the full paper. No outer boundary is reached: every diamond point has 1/2<=x<=3/2 and -1/2<=y<=1/2.

exhaustive_choices.A: Four outer notches modify all four sides; impossible because the removed diamond is strictly internal.
exhaustive_choices.B: Two outer notches modify top/bottom; impossible for the same internal-location invariant.
exhaustive_choices.C: Internal axis-aligned square has horizontal/vertical sides. Reflected original cut lines have slopes +1/-1; no horizontal/vertical hole edge is created.
exhaustive_choices.D: Triangle is not invariant under both crease reflections. Its horizontal base is an old crease, not a new cut, and cannot be a final hole edge.
exhaustive_choices.E: Has exactly the constructed internal diamond with the original outside square. Unique.

mathematics.visibility_scope: The slightly separated display layers reveal four coincident layers without changing the material fold map; all world points, projection matrix, intervals, bands and layer outlines are frozen.

human_semantics: Only the already explicit dashed cutting instruction and A invalid boundary notches are colored. Instruction color is not a paper ink condition. The bands, layer order, folds and correct uncolored E are untouched; E remains the internal diamond under either instruction/annotation reading or an intrinsic color reading of the impossible A option.
native_visual_review: Viewed native 768px: the one original collinear dashed cut has red near its bottom endpoint and blue near its right endpoint, with no new vertex or cut.
